title: Ijwi ryahanganye n'ubutegetsi bw'ikigirwamana
intro: Mu ntumwa z'Imana Ishoborabyose harimo umugaragu uhamye wahagurutse mu ishyanga ryigometse kugira ngo atange ukuri. Abantu babo bari barahisemo imana y'ikinyoma, bava ku Muremyi w'ibiriho byose. Bafite icyemezo kidakuka, uyu muntu arabahamagara ngo bagaruke - ariko ubutumwa bwarahakanywe kandi bwaranzwe. Suzuma ibimenyetso kugira ngo umenye uwo mugaragu w'indahemuka uwo ari we.
clues: Natumwe nk'intumwa ku bantu b'intagondwa bari barayobye kure y'inzira igororotse.
Naje kwibutsa igihugu cyanjye Uwaremye ibiriho byose — Umuremyi mwiza kurusha abandi bose.
Ubwoko bwanjye bwari bwarahindukiriye ikigirwamana cy'ibinyoma bubahaga kandi basengaga ku manywa na nijoro.
Narabahinyuje ntashidikanya, mbabaza impamvu basenga imana y’ibihimbano bagata Umwami wabo w’ukuri.
Baranyihakanye, banze kumva, kandi bakomeje ibinyoma byabo — nyamara Umwami wanjye yaranzigamye.
Ndi Ilyas — kandi amahoro yampaye, kandi nabarwaga mu bagaragu b’abizera b’Imbabazi nyinshi.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Guhamagarira abantu kuva mu gusenga Baali
Umuburo ku bantu ku byerekeye umwuzure ugiye kuza
Kuyobora urugendo rwo kuva mu gihugu cy'ubucakara
trial.answer: Guhamagarira abantu kuva mu gusenga Baali

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yahawe amahoro kandi abarirwa mu bagaragu batoranijwe ba Allah
Bajyanywe muri paradizo mu gihe abandi bose barimbuwe
Yarokowe mu muriro ukomeye wabaye nk'aho urimo gukonja no gutekana
Yahawe ubutware ku majini, abantu, n'umuyaga
Umubiri wabitswe nk'ikimenyetso kirambye mu bihe byose
outcome.answer: Yahawe amahoro kandi abarirwa mu bagaragu batoranijwe ba Allah
